headline: EQUINOX BUYS ORLA for $5.1B: $18.5B Combined Market Cap, Path to 1.9M oz Annual Gold Output
snippet: Equinox Gold has agreed to acquire Orla Mining for approximately US$5.1 billion in a cash-and-stock deal, creating an $18.5-billion North American gold producer with six operating mines anchored by Greenstone, Valentine, and Musselwhite. Shareholders vote in July; deal targets Q3 close.

headline: GOLD $4,703: Metal Stages Deliberate Recovery as Senate Confirms Hawkish Fed Chair Warsh
snippet: Gold rebounded to $4,703/oz on May 14, recovering from the tariff-truce sell-off as hotter-than-expected April PPI data and the Senate's confirmation of hawkish Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the metal's safe-haven bid — up $1,519 versus one year ago.

headline: COPPER SMASHES $6.60/LB ALL-TIME RECORD: AI Data Centers Consume 110,000 Extra Tonnes as Grasberg Stumbles
snippet: Copper futures hit an all-time high above $6.60 per pound on May 13, a 40.86% gain over 12 months, as AI data-center construction demands 110,000 additional tonnes in 2026 alone. Supply is simultaneously squeezed by disruptions at Freeport's Grasberg mine and China's ban on sulfuric acid exports through December.

headline: SILVER SPIKED 7% on US-China Tariff Truce, Ratio Collapsed Below 55 — Then CPI Hit 3.8%
snippet: Silver surged over 7% as the 90-day US-China tariff truce slashed import duties from 145% to 30%, compressing the gold-to-silver ratio below 55 in one of the fastest single-week moves in years. A hotter-than-expected April CPI print of 3.8% then pulled silver back toward $84, with analysts split on whether the industrial demand thesis can hold.

headline: Eagle Nuclear Launches PFS Environmental Baseline at Aurora — Claims Largest Conventional U.S. Uranium Deposit
snippet: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. commenced environmental baseline studies at its Aurora Uranium Project on the Oregon-Nevada border on May 14, advancing toward a pre-feasibility drill program. Management calls it the largest conventional measured-and-indicated uranium deposit in the U.S. — a domestic supply play as American reactors import roughly 95% of their fuel at ~$86.55/lb spot.

headline: Hemlo Mining Discovers New South-Rim Zone Adjacent to Active C-Zone: 16.1 g/t Au over 8.1m
snippet: Hemlo Mining Corp. (TSXV: HMMC) has defined a newly recognized high-grade domain at Ontario's historic Hemlo gold mine, intersecting 16.1 g/t Au over 8.1 metres in the South-Rim Zone directly adjacent to active C-Zone operations. The result supports near-mine, low-capital resource growth within the company's 130,000m 2026 drill program.

headline: Onyx Gold Adds 4th Rig at Munro-Croesus, Expands Program 150% to 110,000m — Posts 99.5m of 1.2 g/t Au
snippet: Onyx Gold Corp. (TSXV: ONYX) has expanded its fully-funded Munro-Croesus drill program to 110,000 metres and deployed a fourth rig 75 km east of Timmins, Ontario, while returning 99.5m of 1.2 g/t Au in the emerging Argus Main target — part of the same gold system as the high-grade Argus North zone.

headline: THE DOLLAR IS SHRINKING: Money Metals on Why the Fed Balance Sheet Is Every Precious Metals Investor's Problem
snippet: Money Metals Exchange argues the Federal Reserve's balance sheet is expanding again — a form of stealth currency debasement that erodes purchasing power regardless of official CPI readings — and makes the case that gold and silver remain the rational structural hedge against an ongoing monetary devaluation cycle.

headline: Silver Price Outlook May 2026: Institutional Analysts Say Stop Chasing the Number — But the Deficit Math Doesn't Lie
snippet: With silver up 150% over 12 months and trading near $85-87/oz, analysts warn against chasing momentum — but note the Silver Institute projects a sixth consecutive annual deficit of ~46 million ounces in 2026 and COMEX registered inventories have fallen from 531M oz to ~315M oz since October 2025, supporting the structural bull case.
